_meta.describes: Ground-truth default badge-slot allocation for full attribute vectors.
_meta.why_it_matters: Slot allocation is NOT additive across attributes, unlike tokens, so it cannot be derived from token_contributions. These are the only records that pin the allocator down - and since the formula in slot_allocator_constants.json does not reproduce them, these records are currently the ONLY reliable source of allocation behaviour. Use them as a lookup, not as a test set for the documented formula.
_meta.source: native probe (2,048 pseudo-random vectors across 10 heights, plus 75 uniform vectors at 75 inches)
notes: Token counts were deliberately omitted: they are exactly reproducible by summing badges/token_contributions.json.
_meta.verification: Audited: every vector is 21 values, slots always sum to slot_total, and slot_total is only ever 0 or 20. Every vector resolves against badges/token_contributions.json. Further established: allocation is a deterministic function of (per-discipline tokens, per-discipline count of qualified badges) - 2,084 distinct keys, zero collisions.
